content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in CSE/IT/AI/ECE/allied branches, along with a valid GATE qualification or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000, which includes HRA at 20%.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow job at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you follow the instructions in the official notification regarding the application format and required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Which city and state is this job located in?
faq.answer: The job is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.
